turn1.explanation: The unit responds to two separate things: cat faces (frontal, eyes and nose region) and cars, especially the front grille and headlight or hood area of cars.
turn1.evidence: Cat faces fill most of the strongest ranks (#1, 2, 4-9 at 7-9), while cars appear at comparable strength (#3 at 9, #10-15 at 6) and make up most of the lower ranks. There is no semantic link between them, though it is possible the shared trigger is a face-like 'two eyes plus central feature' layout (headlights and grille).
turn1.missing_data: Activations on other animal faces and on car-free, cat-free face-like patterns (e.g., dog faces, other vehicles, plain grilles), plus a random sample of non-top images, to test whether a shared frontal face-like configuration explains both.
